reviews.scope: Exact author review of additional notation and scale-restoration algebra in edits78-79; no mathematical deletion or replacement authorized.
reviews.derivation: For a valid finite cohort and positive finite total weight, prognostic restoration is the treatment scale-only average plus the common outcome mean. The public caller passes FALSE; individual evaluation passes TRUE. Translation of all outcomes preserves centered standardized inputs and true contrasts. The new formula exposes the mismatch.
reviewed_assumptions: Existing cohort and posterior-draw alignment remain required.
Raw tree evaluations and monetary constants are stipulated, not upstream outputs.
The permutation example requires jointly reordering all full-sample fields and extracting the treated rows afterward.
Continuous scaling interval is a same-revision documented input convention, not an estimator theorem.

reviews.scope: Author review of additive conditional-DID notation and exact two-group law; no removals.
reviews.derivation: Consistency/no anticipation converts observed baseline to untreated potential outcomes. Conditional untreated-change means agree across groups, so subtracting the baseline group gap from the post group gap identifies the treated conditional effect. Conditional change independence in the paper is sufficient and stronger than this mean condition. Portfolio ATT integrates over treated X. Equal baseline levels are an additional response-model restriction.
reviewed_assumptions: Well-defined branch intervention, no cross-branch interference, no anticipation, overlap and integrable outcomes.
The synthetic branch group fixes untreated level, not untreated change; the latter is constant, so trend independence holds at constant X despite unequal levels.
No universal fitted-forest value or benchmark replication is inferred.
